questions.question: It was the students' lack of preparation that had caused the project to fail.
options: The lack of preparation by the students was what caused the project to fail.
It was the students who lacked preparation that caused the project to fail.
The cause of the project's failure was a lack of student preparation.
A lack of student preparation was the reason for the project's failure.
questions.answer: The lack of preparation by the students was what caused the project to fail.

questions.question: Unless I had studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
options: If I hadn't studied so hard, I might not have passed the exam.
Had I not studied as much, I would probably have failed the exam.
I wouldn't have passed the exam unless I had studied even more.
Unless I had studied less, I definitely would have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If I hadn't studied so hard, I might not have passed the exam.

questions.question: The manager suggested that we should consider the environmental impact of our new factory.
options: The manager advised us to ignore the potential environmental damage from our new factory.
The manager recommended that we take into account the possible environmental consequences of our new factory.
It was suggested by the manager that we disregard any concerns about the environment when building the new factory.
The manager warned us against considering the potential harm to the environment caused by our new factory.
questions.answer: The manager advised us to ignore the potential environmental damage from our new factory.

questions.question: What was it that made her decide to leave her job?
options: It was her job that had made her want to leave.
Her decision to leave her job was what caused her a lot of stress.
The thing that made her decide to leave her job was the lack of opportunities for advancement.
What she decided to do was leave her job because it wasn't fulfilling.
questions.answer: It was her job that had made her want to leave.

questions.question: By the time I arrived, they had already finished the project.
options: I arrived too late for them to have finished the project.
When I got there, they were still working on the project.
It was only after I arrived that they finally completed the project.
They must have finished the project before I even knew it.
questions.answer: I arrived too late for them to have finished the project.
